payload.credit_html: An early Eocene fossil from the British London Clay elucidates the evolutionary history of the enigmatic Archaeotrogonidae (Aves, Strisores) Paleontology Gerald Mayr https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1002/spp2.1392
payload.description_html: Hassiavis cf. laticauda from the latest early or earliest middle Eocene of the Messel fossil site in Germany. A, C, SMF-ME 11702A. B, D, SMF-ME 11702B. In A and B, the fossils were coated with ammonium chloride. Scale bars represent 5 mm.
